policy: Tiers are operator policy, not measured equivalence. Published API benchmarks are not measurements of this proxy. Live models.yml/registry constraints override published capabilities. glm-5.3.tierUncertainty: High. Self-reported table with Z.AI's own harnesses and comparator runs; Fable-level on several rows. Not independently replicated in fetched sources.
